thesis: Generative systems and reusable blueprints apply the same numeric machinery to different tasks and data structures.
role: Explain image synthesis, composition, structured data and training plumbing.

ideas.statement: Diffusion learns to predict added noise and generates by iterative denoising, often conditioned on text and operating in compressed latent space.
Encoder-decoder, dual-encoder, mixture-of-experts and agent designs divide work and move costs; agents are loops implemented by a surrounding program.
Time series require backtesting, graph networks propagate neighbor information, and recommenders separate retrieval from ranking while accounting for feedback and cold starts.
Momentum, learning-rate schedules, initialization, clipping and normalization keep training stable, while position schemes and efficient attention support longer contexts.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The forger and expert explain adversarial generation; the bookshop clerk explains retrieval followed by ranking.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Iterative generation can produce plausible errors and reproduce memorized material; agents compound failures.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
